evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We ask the opposite question: how small can a cybersecurity-specialist transformer be while remaining genuinely useful to a security practitioner?

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The fast path is what the architecture buys: CT0-Micro screens eighty files per second for indicators of compromise, catches its own refusals at 96.5% accuracy in 47 ms where the model judging itself reaches 76.5% in 254 ms and misses half of them, flags jailbreak requests at AUROC 0.966 in 8 ms, and, generating only for the facts it is unsure about, extracts vulnerability facts more accurately than either mode alone at a fifth of the generative cost.
